discovery_summary.fortyguard: 5 endpoints confirmed from quickstart analysis. API key required for live exercise. Cached mode available.
discovery_summary.nws: Live exercise confirmed. Forecast (109-113°F), Extreme Heat Warning, Air Quality Alert for Phoenix. Free, authoritative, no API key.
discovery_summary.usgs: MRLC/NLCD provides 30m tree canopy cover (1985-2025), fractional impervious surface, land cover. Federal authority. Public domain.
discovery_summary.noaa: CDO API documented but requires API key. Not exercised.
discovery_summary.phoenix_gis: ArcGIS services not directly accessible. Documented from planning docs.
discovery_summary.local_context: Maricopa County heat resources, ADEQ air quality, local news. Contextual only.

decisions_pending_owner.description: Provider reallocation: government GIS as primary physical-environment evidence; FortyGuard satellite as optional corroboration
